summary: The game developed is created so that users with fewer/no access to experiments or stimulators can experience and understand the working of a rocket. The game also lets users understand costs and budgeting for a rocket.
details: The game is simple. First, the user must choose their character. Then a mentor explains the stages of a rocket and how it works. The user then has a chance to control the rocket for their journey to the moon before returning to Earth. We have used block coding in Pictoblox. We used text-to-speech so that the game is easier to understand and follow, rather than having to read every step of the way.
